external_source.active_router: AdaptiveStrategy under Phase 2B reduced live mode

reported_performance_not_used_as_evidenc.reason: No committed result artifact and exact data/cost/account reproduction was found beside these code comments. They are discovery signals only.

implementation_findings.finding: The strategy class documents Supertrend ATR10 x 3.0, but does not calculate it.
The orchestrator enriches 4H, 1H, and 15m data through IndicatorEngine.calculate_all() without Supertrend arguments.
Reduced live mode enables only the direct 4H flip and 1H continuation cascade levels. 15m fast and aligned-trend entries are disabled.
The higher-timeframe cascade route was disabled after a code-recorded April 2026 audit of 11 wins in 45 signals (24.4%).
The actual active signal confidence threshold is 45, not the older 25 shown in historical descriptions.
Adaptive routing selects Supertrend only when the 4H regime is TRENDING with ADX>=18 or the detector says RANGING while ADX>=18; QUIET and VOLATILE routes are no-trade in reduced mode.
Direct 4H flip and 1H continuation use 4H ATR, regime-specific 2R brackets, current 1H close as entry reference, and confidence from 4H ADX/EMA9/EMA21/RSI.
Position management outside the signal class activates a trail after +2 ATR, trails by 2.5 ATR, and exits on opposing Supertrend reversal.
The public framework can hold several simultaneous positions and apply dynamic portfolio limits.
implementation_findings.project_adaptation: Run one four-symbol Nautilus account with one global slot and current-NAV 3% planned loss.

flip_only.description: The class-claimed highest-performing 4H direction flip policy only.
flip_only.entry: 4H Supertrend8x2 flips direction and ADX14>=18; current completed 1H close is the entry reference.
flip_only.management: 2R bracket, opposite 4H reversal, +2 ATR activation and 2.5 ATR trail.

entry_order: if none: established 4H direction for >=3 bars plus current aligned 1H and a same-direction 1H flip within the last 8 completed bars

causality_contract: Only completed 1H and 4H bars are used.
The actual live-effective Supertrend8x2 is recomputed rather than the unused class description ATR10x3.
The recent 1H flip episode timestamp, not the current polling bar, prevents repeated entries from one causal flip.
A next-minute fill outside the frozen bracket or above the 3% planned-loss budget is invalidated by actual-fill-v1 without moving the stop.
No website or code-comment performance is substituted for the Nautilus account result.
decision: Implement both source-defined policies as independent one-account experiments. Do not tune period, multiplier, ADX, confidence, lookback, R multiple, or trailing geometry before their clean verdicts.
